ruleDefinitions.name: PowerView PowerShell Cmdlets - ScriptBlock
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Cmdlet names from PowerView of the PowerSploit exploitation framework. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Export\\-PowerViewCSV.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Find\\-DomainLocalGroupMember.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Find\\-DomainObjectPropertyOutlier.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Find\\-DomainProcess.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Find\\-DomainShare.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Find\\-DomainUserEvent.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Find\\-DomainUserLocation.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Find\\-ForeignGroup.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Find\\-ForeignUser.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Find\\-GPOComputerAdmin.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Find\\-GPOLocation.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Find\\-InterestingDomain.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Find\\-InterestingFile.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Find\\-LocalAdminAccess.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Find\\-ManagedSecurityGroups.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-CachedRDPConnection.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-DFSshare.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-DomainDFSShare.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-DomainDNSRecord.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-DomainDNSZone.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-DomainFileServer.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-DomainGPOComputerLocalGroupMapping.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-DomainGPOLocalGroup.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-DomainGPOUserLocalGroupMapping.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-LastLoggedOn.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-LoggedOnLocal.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-NetFileServer.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-NetForest.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-NetGPOGroup.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-NetProcess.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-NetRDPSession.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-RegistryMountedDrive.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-RegLoggedOn.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-WMIRegCachedRDPConnection.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-WMIRegLastLoggedOn.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-WMIRegMountedDrive.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-WMIRegProxy.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Invoke\\-ACLScanner.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Invoke\\-CheckLocalAdminAccess.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Invoke\\-EnumerateLocalAdmin.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Invoke\\-EventHunter.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Invoke\\-FileFinder.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Invoke\\-Kerberoast.*") OR OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Request\\-SPNTicket.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Resolve\\-IPAddress.*"))
